  2. Air Plant (Tillandsia)
  3. Pothos (Epipremnum aureum)
  4. Snake Plant (Sansevieria Trifasciata)

- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Provided tips for choosing plants that complement the blue-gray room: select plants with similar color tones, balance bold colors with subtle ones, consider lighting conditions, and mix different textures.
